home.title: I'm Thanh Nguyen
home.description: I'm Nguyen Phuc Thanh, a Multimedia Engineering graduate from Hanoi University of Science and Technology. My main focus is Android development, but I also take on full-stack tasks when needed. I enjoy building products that are reliable, easy to maintain, and genuinely useful to the people who use them.

about.title: About me
about.personalDescription:
I'm Nguyen Phuc Thanh, an Android developer based in Hanoi.

I currently work at Kalapa JSC, building Android SDK products for the fintech sector in partnership with major banks. Before that, I worked on the Android development of HeyJapan — a Japanese learning app trusted by more than 7 million users.

Beyond Android, I also have experience working on web and backend components when needed, although mobile development remains my main focus. I care a lot about clean architecture, maintainable code, and building systems that can grow over time without becoming difficult to manage.

education.institution: Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST)

workTimeline.jobtitle: Android Developer (Large-scale app development & product optimization)

services.title: Mobile Application Development
services.description: Building high-performance Android (Kotlin) and Flutter applications tailored to real-world use cases, with seamless integration of backend APIs, Firebase services, ML Kit, and third-party SDKs.

services.title: Full-stack Web Development
services.description: Crafting responsive web applications with React or Next.js and robust backend services using Node.js or Flask, with an emphasis on reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

services.title: Machine Learning Integration
services.description: Embedding machine learning models and computer vision capabilities — including OCR, face detection/recognition, and intelligent data analysis — into mobile and web products.

services.title: UI/UX Design & Prototyping
services.description: Designing intuitive, user-centric interfaces and developing rapid prototypes to test and validate ideas before transitioning into full-scale production.

projects.description: Viettel EID/Passport verification app – an Android kiosk solution featuring liveness detection, NFC reading, OCR (MRZ), and integrated payment processing.
A full-stack platform designed to manage Android-based Face Terminal devices, featuring real-time device monitoring, access log tracking, and remote APK updates.
Coffee shop website and mobile app – a full-stack system (React / Node.js / MySQL + React Native) with role-based access, product browsing, and feedback management.
Raincaster – a real-time weather forecasting platform leveraging an SVM model with a Flask backend and React frontend, focused on rainfall prediction.
DSoft – a Flutter-based spa and wellness management application supporting appointment bookings, staff scheduling, inventory tracking, payments, and business analytics.
More open-source projects and experiments are available on my GitHub — feel free to explore.
